Subject: Nimbus vendor portal onboarding — initial scope questions

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for coordinating — I lead security integrations at NimbusCloud. We're ready to onboard Redwood into our Vendr profile and wanted to extract scope up front so we provide the right artifacts. Quick questions so we can populate the CAIQ fragments correctly:

- Can you confirm which of Redwood's products will be in scope (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private)?
- Any region or data residency requirements (US/EU/APAC) we should reflect?
- Do you need KMS rotation evidence (KMS policy + key rotation records) and syslog retention proofs?
- For S3 proof, do you prefer a presigned manifest or direct S3 read-only snapshots?

We can upload CAIQ fragments, a short KMS summary, and an S3 presign sample once scope is finalized. I can also schedule a 30-min kickoff this week.

Attached: nimbus-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (stub)

Best,
Elena

Elena — thanks for the quick note. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Scope: we'll onboard all three surfaces initially (Hosted API + Dedicated + Private). We'll mark Hosted as highest priority for the CAIQ surface area and Dedicated for throughput/ops questions.
- Regions: US + EU; if Vendr requires a single canonical residency field, use "US (primary) / EU (secondary)".
- KMS & syslog: yes, we will provide KMS rotation logs and a summarized syslog retention policy. Exact artifacts are under our security bucket (we can presign).
- S3 evidence: presigned manifests are preferred (we want to avoid giving broad list access).

Can you upload an initial CAIQ fragment in Vendr and share the profile link? Also please include the minimal proof packages (KMS rotation hash + syslog retention excerpt) as attachments — we can pull them into our bridge.

If you have a meeting window on Wednesday 3/24 between 10–12 PT, that works for us.

Thanks,
Mateo

Security Programs | Redwood Inference

Elena / team — quick note before the kickoff tomorrow. Thank you for uploading the initial CAIQ fragment. Two asks from our side so we can avoid a follow-up sprint: 

1) KMS rotation evidence: can you attach the rotation hash file (sha256) plus an index that shows key IDs and rotation timestamps? A single presigned blob is fine.

2) Syslog retention: we need a sample syslog manifest or a redacted syslog extract showing retention enforcement (start/end timestamps). If you can't share extracts, a signed statement on letterhead is acceptable for the early stage.

3) Presign window: thanks for offering 24h. For our ingest playbook we'll request a 3-hour presign window by default (replay risk). Can you make 3h available and open a one-off 24h TTL for the first ingest?

I'm pasting Elena's message below for context.
